taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_typical_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima Myrsinites: low, much-branched, very leafy shrub, 3-10 dm. high, or sometimes spreading and almost prostrate.

traits.height_max_m.note: FEIS species review, Paxistima myrsinites: low growing, reaching heights of 1 to 3 feet (0.3-1 m).

traits.life_span.note: FEIS species review, Paxistima myrsinites: a native, cool-season, evergreen shrub.

traits.woodiness.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima Myrsinites: a low shrub.

traits.leaf_habit.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima: leaves opposite, coriaceous, serrulate, evergreen.

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima: leaves opposite.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima Myrsinites: leaves ovate, oblong or oblanceolate, 15-30 mm. long.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: leaves 5 mm to 12 mm wide, a third to two fifths as wide as long as in the photos.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima Myrsinites: leaves subsessile; about 1 mm to 2 mm, by eye from the photos.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima Myrsinites: leaves ovate, oblong or oblanceolate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima Myrsinites: leaves serrulate.

traits.inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima: flowers solitary or clustered in the axils; peduncles 1-3-flowered.

traits.flowering_position.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima: flowers solitary or clustered in the axils.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima Myrsinites: peduncles 2-3 mm. long, 1-3-flowered.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: each axillary cluster 4 mm to 8 mm long, its peduncle 2 mm to 3 mm (Abrams 1951 p. 54).

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence medium), as no source read gives it: flowers 3 mm to 4 mm across, their petals 1 mm long (Abrams 1951 p. 54).

traits.flower_merosity.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 53, Pachistima: flowers 4-merous (key to genera).

traits.flower_colour.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima Myrsinites: petals reddish brown; maroon in the photos; sRGB by eye.

traits.fruit_type.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima Myrsinites: capsule 4-5 mm. long.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima Myrsinites: capsule 4-5 mm. long.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: capsules brown when ripe.

traits.flowering_months.note: Abrams vol. 3 (1951) p. 54, Pachistima Myrsinites: flowering May to July.

traits.fruiting_months.note: FEIS species review, Paxistima myrsinites: fruits July to September (Arizona, Idaho and Montana).

appearance.note: By eye, from the photos the traits cite: a low, dense, much-branched shrub of small dark glossy leaves in pairs, with tiny maroon flowers in the leaf axils.

generator.params.note: Set by hand for Oregon boxleaf from its sources and the photos the traits cite; the rest of its growth comes from the library's rules for the form. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 0.6 m tall at 12 years in the open, within its sources' range, as grown. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.
